


```{python}
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
```

```{python}
df = pd.read_csv("data/agg_5plus.csv")
```

```{python}
max_var = df.copy()
max_var["max_prop"] = max_var[["a_prop", "b_prop", "c_prop"]].max(axis=1)
```

```{python}
sorted_max_var = max_var.sort_values("max_prop").reset_index(drop=True)
sorted_max_var["total_choices"] = sorted_max_var[["a_chosen", "b_chosen", "c_chosen"]].sum(axis=1)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5))
ax.scatter(sorted_max_var["total_choices"], sorted_max_var["max_prop"], alpha=0.3)
ax.axhline(0.33, color="red", linestyle=":", label="1/3 (lower bound)")
ax.axhline(0.66, color="gray", linestyle=":", label="2/3")
ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax.set_xlabel("Total choices")
ax.set_ylabel("Maximum choice proportion")
ax.set_title("Maximum choice proportion vs. total choices")
ax.legend()
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()

```

```{python}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5))
ax.hist(max_var["max_prop"], bins=np.linspace(0, 1, 31), edgecolor="white")
ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
ax.set_xticks(np.linspace(0, 1, 21))
ax.set_xlabel("Maximum choice proportion")
ax.set_ylabel("Number of triplets")
ax.set_title("Distribution of maximum choice proportions")
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
total_choices = max_var[["a_chosen", "b_chosen", "c_chosen"]].sum(axis=1)
low_count = max_var.loc[total_choices <= 25, "max_prop"]
high_count = max_var.loc[total_choices >= 85, "max_prop"]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5))
ax.hist(
    [low_count, high_count],
    bins=np.linspace(0, 1, 31),
    stacked=True,
    color=["tab:blue", "tab:orange"],
    label=["25 or fewer choices", "85 or more choices"],
    edgecolor="white",
)
ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
ax.set_xticks(np.linspace(0, 1, 21))
ax.set_xlabel("Maximum choice proportion")
ax.set_ylabel("Number of triplets")
ax.set_title("Maximum choice proportions by total choices")
ax.legend()
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
